meta.name: Convert UTC to MENA local time with Hijri seasons and Ramadan send rules

name: Convert UTC timestamps to MENA local time, work week and Ramadan-aware send windows

parameters.content:
## Convert UTC timestamps to MENA local time, work week and Ramadan-aware send windows

Every n8n workspace runs on UTC, and almost every scheduling template assumes a Mon-Fri week. Both are wrong for the Arabic-speaking world: the work week is Sun-Thu, the consumer peak is 19:00-22:00 local, and Ramadan moves that peak past midnight.

Call this sub-workflow from any automation with a timestamp and a country. It returns one typed object telling you what time it really is there.

### How it works

Three Code nodes. No packages, no credentials, no API calls.

1. **Local time and work week** - converts to the target zone, emits an explicit +03:00 offset, and maps the weekday against a per-country weekend table. Also returns `local_day_start_utc` and `local_day_end_utc`, the values your daily rollups should use instead of `CURRENT_DATE`. That is the fix for numbers that appear to reset at 03:00.
2. **Hijri and season** - Umm al-Qura date from Node's built-in ICU, plus Ramadan, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha and Hajj flags.
3. **Daypart and send window** - returns `is_sendable`, and when false a `block_reason` and a `send_after` timestamp you can queue on. Friday 11:00-13:00 is suppressed for everyone.

### Setup

Nothing to configure to try it. Open **Initiate Self Test** and execute: 20 assertions run and print a pass/fail table.

To use it, add an Execute Sub-workflow node in your own workflow and pass `ts_utc`, `tz`, `country` (iq sa ae kw qa bh om jo eg) and `audience` (b2c or b2b).

### Customization

Every country defaults to a Fri-Sat weekend except `ae`, which is Sat-Sun for the public sector since 2022. Edit the `WEEKEND` map in the first and third Code nodes if your market differs.

Pass `holiday_overrides` as `[{ date: "YYYY-MM-DD", country: "iq", name: "Eid" }]` to correct dates. Use `"*"` for all countries. This matters: Umm al-Qura is astronomical, while real Eid dates follow local moon sighting and can differ by a day between neighbouring countries.

## Production entry path

A calling workflow passes ts_utc, tz, country, audience and optional holiday_overrides. Anything missing falls back to Baghdad, Iraq, b2c and now.

## Self-test entry path

Builds 20 assertion cases and feeds them through the same resolver the production path uses. Run it manually after import.

## Resolve time context

Three pure-JS stages shared by both entry paths: local time and Sun-Thu work week, then Umm al-Qura Hijri and season, then daypart and send window.

## Route the output

Self-test runs get a pass/fail table. Real callers get the typed contract, where every timestamp carries an explicit UTC offset, never a naive local time.

parameters.jsCode:
const cases = [
  { name: 'Baghdad Friday is a weekend day', ts_utc: '2026-08-07T09:00:00Z', tz: 'Asia/Baghdad', country: 'iq', audience: 'b2b',
    expect: { weekday_local: 'Fri', is_weekend: true, is_workday: false, is_sendable: false, block_reason: 'weekend', utc_offset: '+03:00' } },
  { name: 'Baghdad Sunday is a workday', ts_utc: '2026-08-09T07:00:00Z', tz: 'Asia/Baghdad', country: 'iq', audience: 'b2b',
    expect: { weekday_local: 'Sun', is_weekend: false, is_workday: true, is_sendable: true, block_reason: null } },
  { name: 'UAE Sunday is a WEEKEND day (Sat-Sun since 2022)', ts_utc: '2026-08-09T07:00:00Z', tz: 'Asia/Dubai', country: 'ae', audience: 'b2b',
    expect: { is_weekend: true, is_workday: false, utc_offset: '+04:00' } },
  { name: 'Baghdad 22:00 local resolves the correct local day start', ts_utc: '2026-08-09T19:00:00Z', tz: 'Asia/Baghdad', country: 'iq', audience: 'b2c',
    expect: { local_hour: 22, local_date: '2026-08-09', local_day_start_utc: '2026-08-08T21:00:00.000Z' } },
  { name: 'Baghdad 00:30 local belongs to the NEXT local day, not the UTC day', ts_utc: '2026-08-09T21:30:00Z', tz: 'Asia/Baghdad', country: 'iq', audience: 'b2c',
    expect: { local_date: '2026-08-10', local_hour: 0, is_sendable: false, block_reason: 'before_window' } },
  { name: 'b2c evening peak is 19:00-22:00 outside Ramadan', ts_utc: '2026-08-09T17:00:00Z', tz: 'Asia/Baghdad', country: 'iq', audience: 'b2c',
    expect: { local_hour: 20, daypart: 'evening_peak', is_sendable: true } },
  { name: 'Friday midday prayer window is blocked', ts_utc: '2026-08-07T09:30:00Z', tz: 'Asia/Baghdad', country: 'iq', audience: 'b2c',
    expect: { local_hour: 12, weekday_local: 'Fri', is_sendable: false, block_reason: 'friday_prayer' } },
  { name: 'A non-Ramadan date reports is_ramadan false', ts_utc: '2026-08-09T12:00:00Z', tz: 'Asia/Baghdad', country: 'iq', audience: 'b2c',
    expect: { is_ramadan: false, ramadan_day: null } },
  { name: 'Civil override marks a holiday and blocks b2b', ts_utc: '2026-08-10T08:00:00Z', tz: 'Asia/Baghdad', country: 'iq', audience: 'b2b',
    holiday_overrides: [{ date: '2026-08-10', country: 'iq', name: 'Test Holiday' }],
    expect: { is_holiday: true, holiday_name: 'Test Holiday', is_sendable: false, block_reason: 'holiday' } },
  { name: 'Override scoped to another country does not apply', ts_utc: '2026-08-10T08:00:00Z', tz: 'Asia/Baghdad', country: 'iq', audience: 'b2b',
    holiday_overrides: [{ date: '2026-08-10', country: 'sa', name: 'Saudi Only' }],
    expect: { is_holiday: false, holiday_name: null } },
  { name: 'Wildcard override applies to every country', ts_utc: '2026-08-10T08:00:00Z', tz: 'Asia/Baghdad', country: 'iq', audience: 'b2b',
    holiday_overrides: [{ date: '2026-08-10', country: '*', name: 'Global Day' }],
    expect: { is_holiday: true, holiday_name: 'Global Day' } },
  { name: 'Cairo resolves its own local weekday', ts_utc: '2026-08-09T10:00:00Z', tz: 'Africa/Cairo', country: 'eg', audience: 'b2c',
    expect: { weekday_local: 'Sun' } },
  { name: 'Before the window queues to 09:00 the same day', ts_utc: '2026-08-09T04:00:00Z', tz: 'Asia/Baghdad', country: 'iq', audience: 'b2c',
    expect: { local_hour: 7, is_sendable: false, block_reason: 'before_window', send_after: '2026-08-09T06:00:00.000Z' } },
  { name: 'After the b2c window queues to 09:00 the next day', ts_utc: '2026-08-09T19:30:00Z', tz: 'Asia/Baghdad', country: 'iq', audience: 'b2c',
    expect: { local_hour: 22, is_sendable: false, block_reason: 'after_window', send_after: '2026-08-10T06:00:00.000Z' } },
  { name: 'b2b Thursday evening queues to Sunday 09:00, skipping Fri-Sat', ts_utc: '2026-08-06T15:00:00Z', tz: 'Asia/Baghdad', country: 'iq', audience: 'b2b',
    expect: { weekday_local: 'Thu', is_sendable: false, send_after: '2026-08-09T06:00:00.000Z' } },
  { name: 'next_workday_start skips the Fri-Sat weekend', ts_utc: '2026-08-07T09:00:00Z', tz: 'Asia/Baghdad', country: 'iq', audience: 'b2b',
    expect: { next_workday_start: '2026-08-09T06:00:00.000Z' } },
  { name: 'Ramadan 22:30 b2c is the peak AND is sendable, not cut off at 21:00', ts_utc: '2026-02-25T19:30:00Z', tz: 'Asia/Baghdad', country: 'iq', audience: 'b2c',
    expect: { is_ramadan: true, ramadan_day: 8, local_hour: 22, daypart: 'evening_peak', is_sendable: true, block_reason: null } },
  { name: 'Ramadan 01:30 b2c is still inside the late window, past midnight', ts_utc: '2026-02-25T22:30:00Z', tz: 'Asia/Baghdad', country: 'iq', audience: 'b2c',
    expect: { is_ramadan: true, local_hour: 1, is_sendable: true, block_reason: null } },
  { name: 'Ramadan 03:00 b2c is past the late window and blocked', ts_utc: '2026-02-26T00:00:00Z', tz: 'Asia/Baghdad', country: 'iq', audience: 'b2c',
    expect: { is_ramadan: true, local_hour: 3, is_sendable: false, block_reason: 'before_window' } },
  { name: 'Ramadan does NOT extend the b2b window', ts_utc: '2026-02-25T19:30:00Z', tz: 'Asia/Baghdad', country: 'iq', audience: 'b2b',
    expect: { is_ramadan: true, local_hour: 22, is_sendable: false, block_reason: 'after_window' } }
];

return cases.map(function (c) {
  return { json: {
    is_self_test: true,
    case_name: c.name,
    expect: c.expect,
    ts_utc: c.ts_utc,
    tz: c.tz,
    country: c.country,
    audience: c.audience,
    holiday_overrides: c.holiday_overrides || []
  } };
});
